sourceHeadRoles.priorEnvironmentCorrectedSourceHead: post-freeze source evidence after selective-breakpoint/environment corrections; not the migration input
sourceHeadRoles.priorSelectorTypographyCorrectedSourceHe: post-freeze source evidence after authored selector/typography corrections; not the migration input

postFreezeSourceDelta.fileCountNote: range file counts are unique paths; segment file counts are not additive when later source commits modify a path already changed in an earlier segment

priorObservedToIntermediateObserved.disposition: source-branch authoring guidance/test correction reviewed but not ported into M6B

intermediateToPriorLatestObserved.disposition: source-branch curriculum corrections reviewed; those findings were subsequently closed on the source branch, but changes are not ported into M6B

priorLatestToLatestObserved.disposition: source-branch curriculum corrections reviewed; those findings were subsequently closed on the source branch, but changes are not ported into M6B

priorGridCorrectedToPriorResponsiveObser.disposition: source-branch responsive fixture correction reviewed; issue remains open and changes are not ported into M6B

priorResponsiveObservedToLatestObserved.disposition: source-branch responsive/environment corrections reviewed; source-only checker addition remains deferred and changes are not ported into M6B

environmentObservedToLatestObserved.disposition: source-branch selector/typography corrections reviewed; authored-check rollout remains deferred and changes are not ported into M6B

selectorTypographyObservedToLatestObserv.disposition: source-branch authored-value/custom-property corrections reviewed; authored-check rollout remains deferred and changes are not ported into M6B

latestObservedUnsupportedCheckerRollout.resolution: latest source-only checker rollout remains deferred; M6B keeps the 13-warning intentional release boundary and does not expand the checker DSL

postFreezeSourceDelta.legacyRuntimeSchemaDisposition: denied; do not import legacy preview-document.ts, preview-messages.ts, or v1 exercise schema
postFreezeSourceDelta.resolution: defer unsupported checker/publication/narrative rollout to the Post-M6B capability roadmap; do not port source-only authoring guidance into the current M6B contract

curriculumAuditCrossCheck.sourcePromotedExercisesWithOpenIssuesAtL: minimum explicitly named promoted Exercise count across currently open #7, #18, #25, and #30; source corrections closed #9, #14, and #15

sourceAuditReport.fullE2E: NOT_PASS — source Task 13 records environment failure and explicitly withholds publication-ready

allowlist: legacy authored assets mapped offline to v2 starter/solution paths
module scaffold and module/lesson reorder logic after v2 review

repeatability: Run `pnpm content:migrate:v1-to-v2 -- --source-root <legacy-css-foundations-root> --target-root <current-css-foundations-root> --dry-run` to emit stable-id/slug/order/status/revision/check-count/source-hash inventory.
